main_text.p: lari quantum inde impendeat periculi & Ecclesiæ & regno; ut nisi maturè prospectum fuerit à Sapientissimo Rege & regni Ephoris, futurum sit, dum lis de lite ducitur circa futilia, saltem non necessaria, ut Papa magnam in Anglia & sementem & messem faciat per suas locustas ex abysso prodeuntes, quorum consiliis clandestinis & artibus veteratoriis per cuniculos molitur subvertere res nostras, vitam, fidem, & Religionem, funestiori successu quam si aperto Marte & Classibus; ut tentatum ab illo anno 1588. id ageret, Avertat Deus hoc malum.
At Vir Nobilissimus & longè illustris de gente laica, atque de illorum choro ad quos scribo, & cui quoque nostra nova Ratio

page.notes: Fragmentary first line ("lari") continues from the previous page. Several words are blurred by show-through from the reverse side; readings such as "ut" before "Papa" and "sementem" are probable but uncertain. The heading word "Admonitio." is set in italic in the running head. Last line "Ratio" is set right-aligned at the foot of the column and may be a catchword-like continuation; it is transcribed as text. The bottom lines of the column are mixed with show-through.
